Storefront and customer routes of the orders module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/orders

List orders

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Orders retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## POST /v1/orders

Create order (authenticated customer or guest)

Parameters:

- `accept-language` in header (string, required).

Request body: [CreateOrderDto](#createorderdto).

Responses:

- `201`: Order created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `403`: Guest checkout disabled.

## GET /v1/orders/{id}

Get order by ID (owner or the guest who placed it)

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Order retrieved.
- `403`: Not the caller's order.
- `404`: Order not found.

## POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel

Cancel order

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Order cancelled.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Order not found.
- `409`: Order cannot be cancelled.

## GET /v1/orders/{id}/invoice

Get order invoice

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Invoice retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Order not found.

## GET /v1/orders/{id}/invoice/pdf

Download order invoice as a branded PDF

Parameters:

- `accept-language` in header (string, required).
- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: PDF stream.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Order does not belong to the caller.
- `404`: Order not found or invoice not ready.

## POST /v1/orders/{orderId}/returns

Create return request

Parameters:

- `orderId` in path (string, required).

Request body: [CreateReturnDto](#createreturndto).

Responses:

- `201`: Return created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Order not found.

## POST /v1/orders/track

Track an order by number and email

Request body: [TrackOrderDto](#trackorderdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Order tracking data.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `404`: Order not found.

## Schemas

### AddressDto

- `fullName` (string, required).
- `phone` (string, required).
- `addressLine1` (string, required).
- `addressLine2` (string, optional).
- `city` (string, required).
- `state` (string, optional).
- `postalCode` (string, optional).
- `country` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{2}$/`, required).

### CreateOrderDto

- `guestEmail` (string, optional).
- `shippingAddressId` (string, optional).
- `shippingAddress` ([AddressDto](#addressdto), optional).
- `billingAddressId` (string, optional).
- `billingAddress` ([AddressDto](#addressdto), optional).
- `shippingMethodId` (string, optional).
- `paymentMethodCode` (string, optional).
- `notes` (string, optional).
- `giftCardCode` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z0-9]{8,20}$/`, optional).
- `couponCode` (string, optional).

### CreateReturnDto

- `items` (array of [ReturnItemDto](#returnitemdto), required).
- `reason` (object, required).
- `reasonDetail` (string, max length 1000, optional).
- `photoAssetIds` (array of string, optional).
- `refundMethod` (object, optional).

### ReturnItemDto

- `orderItemId` (string, required).
- `quantity` (number, min 1, required).
- `exchangeVariantId` (string, optional).

### TrackOrderDto

- `orderNumber` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z0-9-]+$/`, max length 32, required).
- `email` (string, max length 254, required).
